name: @lawsynth/docs-site
description: Deterministic static documentation compiler for LawSynth.

scripts.render: npm run build && node render-static.mjs public
scripts.deploy: npm run render && wrangler pages deploy public --project-name lawsynth
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test dist/tests/api_reference.test.js dist/tests/benchmarks.test.js dist/tests/blog.test.js dist/tests/code.test.js dist/tests/examples.test.js dist/tests/markdown.test.js dist/tests/navigation.test.js dist/tests/search.test.js dist/tests/site.test.js tests/render_static.test.mjs
